subtasks.description: Define query intents that require exact SQL aggregates versus evidence retrieval.
Index normalized lexical text and versioned embeddings with tenant, record ACL and revision metadata.
Apply authorization filters before retrieval and enforce them again on evidence access; test approximate filtered recall.
Add bounded hybrid search/reranking and visible source/time/quality filters.
Implement read-only allowlisted analytical tools with row/time limits, deterministic numeric results and cited answers.
Add abstention, unsupported-question handling and transcript prompt-injection defenses.
Evaluate 100 approved business questions plus adversarial tenant/team cases and deletion/reindex scenarios.
